patch_description: Crossover combining the fast clipped soft-min/soft-max surrogate (no logsumexp, from the 10.3s program), the indexed-pair distance computation, and the targeted hard-ratio polish with pair moves on binding constraints. Uses the efficient 3-phase schedule: seed sweep with clipped anneal ladder, perturb-and-reanneal with hard polish around the incumbent, and tiny-kick low-temperature polish. This keeps the quality of the full pipeline while cutting eval time roughly 3-5x versus the slow logsumexp variant.
